_comment: hf7y/senechal#396/#408: classifies every tracked mechanism file as fleet (every self-dev host's unattended run may need it), taste (mandark/Zach only), shared (infrastructure consumed by both halves), or meta (repo governance out of scope for this pass). Merges the two registries hf7y/senechal#401 (tools/boundary.py, in-file dict) and hf7y/senechal#397 (tools/repo-boundary.py, registry/repo-boundary.json) into one, per hf7y/senechal#408. Test applied per entry, Zach's own words (2026-08-23): would another machine's unattended nightly-batch/health run ever need to read this? Ambiguous items default to fleet (Zach, 2026-08-24) -- the costs are asymmetric, a taste item wrongly in the fleet is dead weight, a fleet item wrongly in taste is a broken unattended run elsewhere.
_criterion: would another self-dev fleet host's UNATTENDED run ever need to read this? (#396's own test)

_classes.fleet: self-dev necessary -- every self-dev host's unattended run may need this
_classes.taste: mandark/Zach only -- the other machines never need it
_classes.shared: infrastructure consumed by both halves -- would need to exist on both sides of a split, or become a common dependency
_classes.meta: repo governance/documentation that does not cleanly belong to one half and is out of scope for this pass
